reason: S1 introduces the selectable Prague EVM-version state, including the "prague" string accepted by EVMVersion::fromString and advertised by CommandLineParser::options, but H0 has no structured path selecting it. Consequently, Prague-specific version parsing, configuration propagation, and compilation are materially under-fuzzed.
evidence: EVMVersion.h adds EVMVersion::prague(), includes prague() in EVMVersion::fromString(), and maps Version::Prague to the input/output string "prague" in EVMVersion::name().
CommandLineParser::options expands the documented --evm-version values to include "prague".
FuzzerUtil::testCompiler selects only from s_evmVersions, whose newest entry is EVMVersion::paris(); Prague cannot be selected there.
FuzzerUtil::testCompilerJsonInterface fixes settings.evmVersion to "berlin", so its generated Standard JSON inputs never exercise "prague".
ProtoConverter::evmVersionMapping has cases only through Program::CANCUN and contains no Prague program version or EVMVersion::prague() mapping.
H0 invokes CompilerStack and solidity_compile but contains no CommandLineParser entry point exercising the --evm-version prague CLI protocol.
recommended_action: Add Prague to every structured version domain in H0: include EVMVersion::prague() in s_evmVersions, allow testCompilerJsonInterface to generate settings.evmVersion="prague", extend the Program version/protobuf and ProtoConverter::evmVersionMapping with Prague, and fuzz CommandLineParser handling of --evm-version values including valid "prague" and malformed neighboring strings.
